notes: The Bloomheart Matriarch is the Amethyst Sovereign's Tripo tree spirit, re-rigged on the treant class instead of studio mode: the production clips sank (Hit 0.20 m, Walk 0.05 m), the cape strips cut through the right leg and arm in Death, and the leaf skirt swung sideways as one sheet in the cast. The treant fit and attach step keep the crown on the head; the leaf skirt is a ring of spring columns round the pelvis (treant skirt) with leg and arm colliders, so it trails, sways and settles with the body; the hips and legs are given (the fit set them off the midline, as on the sovereign). It casts (Spell_Simple); in Death the skirt lies with the body (hang 0, raised clearance so the sheet between columns stays above the floor) and the arms hold the idle carry. It gains a Run (Jog_Fwd_Loop).
